summary_1line: Counsel on espionage and kingship is given, then Bhima meets Hanuman who promises aid in battle before Bhima continues his quest for Saugandhika lotuses.

image_candidates.scene_text: The giant monkey Hanuman shrinks to normal size and embraces Bhima, whose exhaustion vanishes in his brother’s arms.
Hanuman promises to stand upon Arjuna’s chariot banner roaring over the battlefield to terrify the enemy.
Bhima strides through the lush Gandhamadana forest toward a river filled with glowing golden Saugandhika lotuses and circling swans.
